Personally, I had thought of adding their pieces in our kitchen, but in my mind, the Courtly Check would not “flow well” with my cool and creamy soft tones that the room is comprised of. However, while looking for different products to include in my friend’s kitchen, I saw that they had a whole array of “new” color ways!

I was so excited and started to immediately mull over which one would be the most streamline fit, and the sterling was the winner by far! It goes so subtlety beautiful with my color scheme of cream, white and grey, along with the paint color, Sea Salt, but it especially highlights my mother-of-pearl backsplash above the oven, where it sits.

After receiving it and seeing in-person how well it worked, I happily purchased a bunch of other accessories in the sterling for my kitchen and cannot wait to see it all come together!

I believe that these pieces are a great investment because if I can remember them from when I was a kid, they have truly stood the test of time. Now that I’m older, I’m more prone to purchase items that are more everlasting than trendy…. I guess it’s partially for sentimental reasons, but there’s also something so comforting in knowing that you’re always going to love a special item rather than constantly look for the next “in” thing to replace it with.

review_title: Stylish Storage with a Catch — Beautiful, But Not Airtight
review_text: I recently purchased the MACKENZIE-CHILDS Cookie Jar with Enamel Lid in the Gray-and-White Sterling Check, and while the design is absolutely charming, I was left a bit disappointed. The color scheme fits perfectly with my kitchen decor, and the craftsmanship is what you’d expect from MacKenzie-Childs — elegant, whimsical, and visually striking.One thing I will say right away: it was packaged extremely well. Everything arrived in perfect condition, securely wrapped and protected — a clear sign of the brand’s attention to detail and care in shipping.However, the functionality didn’t quite meet my expectations. The jar lacks a gasket or any kind of airtight seal, which is a big miss for something marketed as a cookie jar. Unfortunately, that means anything perishable like cookies, crackers, or baked goods will go stale fairly quickly.Because of this, I’ve decided to repurpose it for individually wrapped snacks. It still looks great on the counter, but it’s definitely more form than function. I had originally planned on buying the full canister set to match, but now I’m hesitant. If those canisters also lack a proper seal, I’m afraid I’ll run into the same issue — and that just doesn’t work for everyday kitchen storage.
